name: library-docs
instructions: Use the benchmark workspace copy of library-docs/scripts. Search with QUERY --library kubernetes --limit 5 --json. Read chunks via read.py or original corpus files for exact citations. No network or reindex during questions.

args: cp -R "{source}" "{workspace}/library-docs" && rm -f "{workspace}/library-docs/data/library.db" && "C:/Python313/python.exe" -c "import pathlib,sys; [print(p) for p in sorted(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).rglob('*.md'))]" "{docs}" | "C:/Python313/python.exe" "{workspace}/library-docs/scripts/index.py" kubernetes --batch

import sqlite3,sys,pathlib; db=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); actual={row[0].split("##",1)[0] for row in db.execute("SELECT path FROM documents")}; expected={str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).rglob("*.md")}; assert len(expected)==409 and actual==expected, (len(actual),len(expected),sorted(expected-actual)[:3]); print("Verified all 409 source paths in index")
